NEO Emacs (WIP): GPU powered Emacs written in Rust with a modern display engine. Aiming for modern design & multi-threaded Elisp, 10x performance, zero-pause concurrent GC and 100% Emacs compatibility.
Turn AI conversations into organized, reusable workflows — across major AI platforms. | 把 AI 对话转化为可组织、可复用的工作流，适用于主流 AI 平台

CoCo Super Intelligence is the orchestration layer that turns Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex into an engineering department: a routed advisory board, 226 skills, 386 commands, persistent state. Local. Open-core — MIT core; Super Intelligence is proprietary, own-use.
A free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 11. Glass fences, live folders, tabs, Peek. Rust, ten languages, portable.

Win顺：免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器。双击 Ctrl，拼音秒搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史（代替 Win+V）、对话框搜索、任务栏搜索、插件、AI 助手 MCP。Free Windows search launcher: pinyin file search, full-text search, clipboard history, MCP server. Everything/Listary alternative.
The next-generation Markdown editor, with an AI writing assistant. Free and open source for macOS, Windows and Linux.
Fast, free voice assistant for your Mac. No API key: runs on your Claude Pro or Max plan. Sends background agents for big jobs, remembers you and learns your shortcuts. Hold ⌃⌥Space and talk.

A lightweight PC Dynamic Island that integrates QQ, WeChat, and email notifications, clipboard history, quick translation, a Codex status light, media controls, daily to-dos, and more. | 轻量的PC灵动岛，集成QQ、微信及邮箱通知、剪贴历史、快捷翻译、Agent状态灯、媒体控制、每日待办等功能
Open-source workspace for professional document AI: reviewable agent edits, source-linked work, three-way document merges, and an extensible plugin runtime. Starting with legal work.
One macOS app for Claude Code, Codex, and every agent runtime you use — scheduled runs, global hotkey launcher, per-run git worktrees, one review board.

Your work, already underway. A personal AI assistant for your job: mail, chats and tickets become tasks, the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Open source, runs on your machine.
Personal AI Agent Hub 2026 — Build Your 24/7 Autonomous Assistant

Self-hosted AI workspace with agents, skills, and tools (Gmail, Calendar) that runs entirely on your own provider API keys (BYOK). Bring your own keys — Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Google AI.
